title: Learnt Attacks on Quantum Key Distribution under Channel Noise and Device Drift
abstract: arXiv:2610.01792v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum key distribution (QKD) links are provisioned from security analyses of stationary channels, whereas the devices that determine the channel drift between recalibrations. Whether an eavesdropper who cannot alter the channel's own noise gains by following that drift has not been quantified. Adaptive eavesdropping is posed here as a constrained Markov decision process in which the attacker selects one circuit per round while the noise level follows an Ornstein--Uhlenbeck process and the abort condition is a budget over each block of rounds. The value of adaptation is bounded by the best fixed circuit and a dynamic-programming upper bound. The actions are learnt attacks. Whereas Decker et al. trained a parametrised circuit on a fixed gate template against a fixed channel, here the gate structure and rotation angles are searched jointly. translated_title: 信道噪声与设备漂移下对量子密钥分发的学习型攻击
translated_abstract: 量子密钥分发（QKD）链路是基于平稳信道的安全性分析来配置的，而正是设备决定了两次重新校准之间信道的漂移。一个无法改变信道自身噪声的窃听者是否能通过跟随这种漂移而获益，此前尚未被量化。本文将自适应窃听建模为一个受约束的马尔可夫决策过程：攻击者在每一轮选择一个电路，噪声水平遵循Ornstein–Uhlenbeck过程，中止条件为对每一轮块设定的预算限制。自适应的价值由最佳固定电路性能和动态规划上界所限定，而动作本身即是学习得到的攻击。与Decker等人在固定门模板上针对固定信道训练参数化电路不同，本文对门结构和旋转角度进行联合搜索。由此得到的电路足够紧凑，可以构成一个离散的动作集合，从而将该构造扩展至……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次将信道噪声与设备漂移下的自适应量子窃听攻击建模为受约束马尔可夫决策过程，通过联合搜索量子电路的门结构与旋转角度学习出紧凑的攻击策略，并用动态规划上界量化了窃听者跟随信道漂移所能获得的收益。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates adaptive eavesdropping on QKD under channel noise and device drift as a constrained Markov decision process, jointly searching gate structures and rotation angles to learn compact attack circuits, and bounds the value of an attacker following channel drift via dynamic programming.
